title: qa-loop-release-ac ac-matrix.json — every acceptance criterion in a release, and what happened to it
description: Version 2.0.0 (BREAKING: rows carry `case_dir` instead of `case_id`/`test`; `run_url` and `summary.unmatched_receipts` are gone; `fix_version` is now `release_name`, matching what `matrix` has always emitted). Emitted by the `qa-loop-release-ac` recipe (`release_ac.mjs matrix`). One row per Gherkin scenario (or explicit prose AC bullet) found in the issue-tracker tickets a release label names, joined to the qa-run-case receipt (`case-run.json`) of the case file `release_ac.mjs cases` wrote for it (or qa-run-chatbot's grade for chat-class scenarios). `summary.verdict` is deliberately strict: `all-ac-pass` only when every scenario was judged and passed — a run where the automated half is green and the manual half was never run is `automated-pass-with-gaps`, never a pass. Not consumed by the control plane — QA / release-owner facing.

release_version.description: The version the release label carries (vcs_host / ci_cd adapters), e.g. "21.0.0".

release_name.description: The issue-tracker release name it reconciled against (named per integrations.release_ac.release_name_pattern), e.g. "Release 21.0.0".

env.description: The environment the scenarios ran against (never production).

manual.description: Scenarios a person must run (email, mobile, voice, time-travel, destructive billing, server-side) that have no result yet.

not_deployed.description: Scenarios whose PR's merge commit is not in the environment's build — skipped, never failed.

dev_gate.description: AC that is a developer gate (typecheck, lint, unit tests) — owned by qa-regression / dev-pre-pr, not by this run.

tickets_without_ac.description: In-scope tickets with no Gherkin and no acceptance-criteria bullets. A finding for the reporter; nothing is invented for them.

descoped.description: Scenarios the PR description or a ticket comment explicitly cut from this release — quoted in class_why, never silently dropped.

scenario_id.description: <issue key>#S<n> — stable for a given ticket body.

case_dir.description: The scenario's qa-run-case directory (`<cases out-dir>/<KEY>-S<n>/`, holding case.json and, once run, case-run.json); null for a scenario that got no case file (manual, chat, not deployed, too thin, dev gate, descoped).
